content_sections.heading: PJTAU Teaching Associate Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the PJTAU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: PJTAU Teaching Associate Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Teaching Associate (Full Time) - Post 1: Ph.D in Food Technology/Food Process Technology or M.Tech in Food Technology/Food Process Technology/ Food Process Engineering/ Food Engineering/ Processing and Food Engineering from an ICAR recognized University/ Institution with B.Tech. in Food Technology. Teaching Associate (Full Time) - Post 2: Ph.D in Food Quality Assurance/ Food Safety and Quality Assurance or Masters in Food Quality Assurance/ Food Safety and Quality Assurance/ Food Science and Nutrition from an ICAR recognized University/ Institution with B.Tech. in Food Technology.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PJTAU Teaching Associate (Full Time) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Professor Jayashankar Telangana Agricultural University (PJTAU) for filling full-time teaching associate positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by PJTAU?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Teaching Associate (Full Time) under the College of Food Science and Technology located in Rudrur, Telangana.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Teaching Associate (Full Time) post across different specialization streams.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application and selection process is entirely based on a Walk-in Interview. Eligible candidates can directly appear for the interview on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 29 September 2026. Candidates must report to the venue on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D or Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Process Technology, Food Process Engineering, Food Quality Assurance, or Food Science and Nutrition with an undergraduate degree in Food Technology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered for Teaching Associates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates with a Ph.D degree will receive Rs. 54,000 per month, while those without a Ph.D will receive Rs. 49,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories. It is completely free of cost.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for these positions?
faq.answer: The job location for these contractual teaching associate positions is Rudrur in the state of Telangana.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and details?
faq.answer: You can check the official notification PDF and get all updates by visiting the important links section provided in this recruitment article.
